plan.notes: Source: https://catalog.qu.edu/engineering/computing/computer-science-bs/ (Quinnipiac 2026-2027 Academic Catalog; verified catalog year from catalog.qu.edu home page '2026-27 Catalog'). Transcription: manual transcription of the official 'Plan of Study Grid' term-by-term, cross-checked against the degree requirements table and the Department of Computing course descriptions (catalog.qu.edu/engineering/computing/computing.pdf) for titles and prerequisites. Lab components folded into parent course codes (e.g. 'CSC 110' = CSC 110 & 110L, 4 cr; 'SER 120' = SER 120 & 120L, 4 cr). CREDIT DISCREPANCY (honest): the degree requires a MINIMUM of 120 credits, but the official plan-of-study grid prints term totals 16/14/16/16/16/15/15/15 summing to 123; total_credits uses the sequence's OWN published total (123) per the Clarkson/UVM/GCSU precedent. Blank (unlabeled) grid rows are modeled as student-choice slots; they satisfy CSC electives (9 cr), additional MA courses (6 cr: MA 150/153/154/285/301/305/318/321/370/378), UC Personal Inquiry, and open coursework per catalog requirements. Catalog note: minimum grade C- required for all CS course prerequisites. ENR 395 requires junior status in the major; ENR 410 requires senior status in the major (status conditions, not course prereqs, so not modeled in prereq arrays).
